=== enter between braces
--- before
fn f() {¦}
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
fn f() {
    ¦
}

=== enter after open brace keeps going
--- before
pub fn main() void {¦
--- keys
<enter>x();
--- after
pub fn main() void {
    x();¦

=== electric closer
--- before
fn f() {
    x();
    ¦
--- keys
}
--- after
fn f() {
    x();
}¦

=== autoclose paren
--- before
const a = f¦;
--- keys
(1
--- after
const a = f(1¦);

=== overtype closer
--- before
const a = f¦;
--- keys
(1)
--- after
const a = f(1)¦;

=== no autoclose in string
--- before
const s = "a¦";
--- keys
(
--- after
const s = "a(¦";

=== no autoclose in comment
--- before
// see ¦
--- keys
[
--- after
// see [¦

=== quote pair and backspace
--- before
const s = ¦;
--- keys
"<bs>
--- after
const s = ¦;

=== surround selection
--- before
const a = «b + c»;
--- keys
(
--- after
const a = («b + c»);

=== multi cursor enter
--- before
fn f() {¦}
fn g() {¦}
--- keys
<enter>
--- after
fn f() {
    ¦
}
fn g() {
    ¦
}

=== line comment toggle on
--- before
«fn f() void {
    x();
}»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«// fn f() void {
//     x();
// }»

=== line comment toggle off
--- before
«// a
    // b»
--- keys
<lc>
--- after
«a
    b»

=== trailing whitespace on enter
--- before
fn f() {
    ¦
--- keys
<enter><enter>x
--- after
fn f() {


    x¦
